name: Status
description: Status data collected for a server or instance.

object_class.label: Target class
object_class.description: Class of the server or instance associated with this status.
object_class.help: Assigned automatically when the status is collected.

object_id.label: Target ID
object_id.description: Identifier of the server or instance associated with this status.
object_id.help: Assigned automatically when the status is collected.

status_data.label: Status data
status_data.description: JSON data containing the collected state and statistics.
status_data.help: Contains the complete response returned by the monitoring endpoint.

status_data_excerpt.label: Status summary
status_data_excerpt.description: Summary of the latest collected status data.
status_data_excerpt.help: Displays the principal state and resource usage values.

is_collection_ok.label: Collection successful
is_collection_ok.description: Whether the status collection completed successfully.
is_collection_ok.help: Disabled when the monitoring endpoint could not be reached or returned an error.

scopes.label: Scopes
scopes.help: Possible scopes are instant, state, and config.
